settings.heading: Download data
settings.intro: Get a copy of everything about your account in one ZIP file: a data file (JSON) that other apps can read, and every story as a Word (.docx) file and a PDF.

includes.library: Your library shelves, with each story’s title and link (also as a spreadsheet, library.csv)
includes.account: Your account: username, pen name, year of birth, email address and the age check
includes.settings: Your settings, consents and the reports you made

settings.everythingNote: Everything above is in the data file. Your stories are also there as Word files and PDFs, so you can open them, edit them, print them or send them on.

stories.heading: Download stories
stories.intro: Get your stories as Word (.docx) files you can edit, or as PDFs ready to print or send to an agent: every chapter, drafts too, with the dates. You can add each story’s plan from Story Atlas and a machine-readable copy.
stories.hint: We’ll tell you when they’re ready. The link works only while you’re logged in and stops working after seven days. One file comes as it is; more come in one ZIP.
stories.none: You haven’t started a story yet. Once you have, you can download it here as a Word file or a PDF.
stories.preparing: We’re making your files on this device. You can keep using the app, but keep this tab open until they’re ready. We’ll send you a notification when they are.
stories.reused: Nothing has changed since you made these a little while ago, so here they are again.
stories.failed: We couldn’t make the files. Try again in a minute.
stories.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your stories. Reload the page to try again.

epub.heading: An EPUB for e-readers
epub.intro: This story is completed, so you can make it into an EPUB book for Kindle or any other e-reader: the cover, a copyright page, the contents, then every published chapter. The plan from Story Atlas isn’t included.
epub.dialogIntro: Check what the book will print. These details stay on this device: we don’t save them.
epub.nameHint: Your pen name, or any name you want printed as the author, your own name included. We don’t keep it, so type it each time.
epub.coverFileHint: JPEG or PNG. It goes into the book only: we don’t upload it.
epub.making: Making the EPUB on this device…
epub.saved: Your EPUB is saved as {{fileName}}. Open it in your e-reader’s app, or send it to your Kindle.
epub.failed: We couldn’t make the EPUB. Try again.

guide.title: Data, explained
guide.intro: This is your copy of everything {{productName}} keeps about you, made on {{date}}. This page says what each file and folder holds.

files.data: data.json: everything about your account, in a format other apps can read. You can open it in any text editor.
files.stories: stories/: each of your stories as a Word file (.docx) and a PDF.
files.plans: stories/<story>-plan.docx and .pdf: the plan of each story from Story Atlas.
files.library: library.csv: library shelves, as a spreadsheet.

parts.format: format and made_at: which kind of file this is and when it was made.
parts.user_id: user_id: your account’s ID. It never changes and is never shown publicly.
parts.account: account: your email address, your profile (username, pen name, language and settings), when you joined and the ways you log in.
parts.library: library: your library shelves, with a link to each story.
parts.tables: tables: everything else, in groups. Each group is listed below.

tables.account_deletions: When you asked to delete your account, and whether you changed your mind.
tables.account_last_used: The last day you used the account, and when the notices about an unused account were sent.
tables.age_check_attempts: Each time you checked your age: the result and the date, never a photo.
tables.chapter_embeds: Music and video links you put in your chapters.
tables.chapter_moves: Each time a chapter moved to a new place in a story you reordered.
tables.chapter_plan_characters: Which characters appear in each chapter of your plans.
tables.comment_downvotes: The comments you voted down. Only you and staff ever see these.
tables.consents: What you agreed to (terms, privacy notice) and when.
tables.conversation_members: The private chats you are part of.
tables.customisation_change_requests: Moderators’ requests to change your signature or profile look.
tables.finished_thanks: The thank-you notes you sent writers when you finished their stories.
tables.forum_post_votes: The forum posts you voted on, and which way.
tables.forum_read_marks: Where you marked forums as read.
tables.forum_thread_reads: How far you have read in each forum thread.
tables.held_about_you: What we hold about you: sanctions on your account, what moderators hid or removed of yours, staff changes to your stories and the reasons, restrictions, copied-work notes, your data requests, the scrambled address from sign-up and, if you work for us, your staff roles. Staff names and internal notes are left out.
tables.home_comment_picks: Comments staff asked to show on the home page, and the answer you gave.
tables.landing_page_reminders: Reminders you asked for on contest and campaign pages.
tables.learning_path_progress: The days of the learning path you marked done.
tables.library_entries: Your library shelves, as saved in the app.
tables.live_session_reminders: The live sessions you asked to be reminded of.
tables.manual_age_checks: Requests for a person to check your age by hand.
tables.member_last_active: The last day you were in the app.
tables.notification_email_settings: Which notifications you get by email.
tables.parental_consents: What your parent or guardian agreed to, and when.
tables.picture_checks: The checks on pictures you uploaded.
tables.reading_list_stories: Which stories are in each reading list, and when each was added.
tables.reading_lists: Reading lists: each name and whether it is public.
tables.reading_minutes: Minutes you read on each recent day, for your streak.
tables.reading_positions: Where you stopped in each story.
tables.reading_preferences: The categories and tags you said you like.
tables.reading_settings: How you like to read: text size, font and night mode.
tables.space_join_notes: The notes you sent with requests to join a space.
tables.space_moderation_log: What you did as a space moderator.
tables.statements_of_reasons: Why moderators removed or limited something of yours.
tables.support_tickets: Messages to support and the answers.
tables.teacher_checks: The request for the Teacher badge.
tables.waitlist_entries: Your place on the waiting list: when you joined, what you said you came for (write, read or both) and when you were let in.
tables.writer_spotlights: Times you were picked as writer of the week, and the answer you gave.
tables.writing_days: How many new words you wrote each day (never the words themselves).

first.heading: Download stories first
first.body: Once your account is deleted, your stories are gone for good. Save every story and its plan as Word files now. You’ll stay on this step.
